title: DOMINO CLASSIC
one_line: Classic Draw and Block dominoes against smart computer opponents, with a new daily challenge every day.
how_to_play: Tap a glowing tile, then tap the gold end of the chain to place it. Stuck? Draw (or pass in Block mode). Empty your hand first.
description: A polished take on classic dominoes. Play Draw or Block dominoes for 2 players, or team up with a partner in 4-player games. Three computer levels (Easy, Medium, Hard), a hard daily challenge with the same deal for everyone, hints, statistics and a winning streak to beat. Works on phones, tablets and desktop, and runs fully offline once loaded.
